sources.title: Phi-3.5-mini-instruct-4bit - promptlayer.com
sources.snippet: What is Phi-3.5-mini-instruct-4bit? Phi-3.5-mini-instruct-4bit is a quantized version of Microsoft's Phi-3.5-mini-instruct model, specifically optimized for the MLX framework and designed to run efficiently on Apple Silicon hardware. This model represents a significant optimization effort by the MLX community to make advanced language models more accessible and performant on Apple devices ...
